name: Limit Diagnostic Data to Required
description: Sets diagnostic telemetry to Required (level 1) instead of Optional/Full, preventing capture of visited websites, inking/typing, and extended app telemetry while preserving Windows Update compatibility.

name: Disable Advertising ID
description: Stops apps from using the advertising identifier for experiences across apps and ad networks.

name: Disable Activity History Publishing
description: Prevents Windows from recording user activity timelines and syncing them to Microsoft servers.

name: Disable Activity History Upload
description: Prevents uploading user activity history to the Microsoft cloud account.

name: Disable Start Menu Bing Web Search
description: Prevents Start menu search queries from being sent across the web to Bing servers. Keeps search completely local, private, and instant.

name: Disable Connected Search in Windows Search
description: Disables connected web search integration in Windows Search indexing.

name: Disable Tailored Experiences
description: Prevents Microsoft from using diagnostic data to offer personalized recommendations, ads, and tips.

name: Disable Silent Sponsored App Pre-installation
description: Prevents Windows Content Delivery Manager from silently downloading third-party promotional apps in the background.

name: Disable Diagnostic Feedback Prompts
description: Sets feedback frequency to Never so Windows does not periodically interrupt user with feedback rating prompts.

name: Block Microsoft Account Enforcement & Cloud Login Prompts
description: Enforces offline local user accounts only. Disables Windows setup and Settings from prompting or forcing a Microsoft cloud account.

name: Permanently Disable Automatic Windows Updates
description: Sets NoAutoUpdate to 1 via Group Policy to permanently prevent Windows Update from checking or downloading updates.

name: Configure Windows Update to Never Check
description: Sets AUOptions to 1 (Never check for updates) in Windows Update Group Policy.

name: Remove Windows Update Access in Settings UI
description: Removes access to all Windows Update features and scans from the Windows Settings app.

name: Disable Access to Windows Update Infrastructure
description: Completely disables user and background access to Windows Update scanning infrastructure.

name: Exclude Drivers from Windows Updates
description: Prevents Windows Update from silently downloading and overwriting graphics or hardware drivers.

name: Disable Delivery Optimization Peer Networking
description: Disables peer-to-peer update distribution and background bandwidth consumption.

name: Enable System Dark Theme by Default
description: Enforces dark mode for the Windows 11 Taskbar, Start Menu, and System flyouts.

name: Enable Application Dark Theme by Default
description: Enforces dark mode for Windows 11 applications, File Explorer, and Settings.
